cells.name: quicksilver
cells.species: domain-warped fbm read as flowing chrome
eq: a = fbm₂(sq),  b = fbm₂(sq + w·a),  h = fbm(sq + w·b)/s
chrome = env(r)·(F₀ + (1 − F₀)(1 − n_z)⁵),  r = reflect(−v, n)

cells.name: mercury_pool
cells.species: drips spread damped rings over a still mercury pool
eq: x = |p − cᵢ| − 0.8φ,  φ = fract(rate·t + i/4),  4 drips
chrome = env(r)·(F₀ + (1 − F₀)(1 − n_z)⁵),  r = reflect(−v, n)

cells.name: hammered
cells.species: Worley dimples beaten into pewter under a swinging light

cells.name: brushed_plate
cells.species: linear brushed steel with an anisotropic streak highlight

cells.name: spun_disc
cells.species: a lathe-spun disc; the bowtie highlight turns with the light

cells.name: liquid_gold
cells.species: slow rolling domain warp poured as molten gold (own tint)
eq: h = warped fbm (as quicksilver) on p·(1, 1.3)
chrome = env(r)·(F₀ + (1 − F₀)(1 − n_z)⁵),  r = reflect(−v, n)

cells.name: silk_ribbons
cells.species: stacked warped sine folds glowing as silk ribbons
eq: ribbon i: cᵢ(x) = A(0.7 sin(f₁x + ω₁t) + 0.3 sin(f₂x − 0.5t)) + offset

cells.name: prism_ribbons
cells.species: the ribbon stack drawn three times, split per color channel
eq: three ribbon stacks at y ± o, one per R, G, B

cells.name: cinched_silk
cells.species: diagonal ribbons pulled through a gaussian waist to knife edges

cells.name: thread_veil
cells.species: a veil of fine silk threads, each with a soft halo

cells.name: satin_drape
cells.species: a draped satin sheet with a broad sheen along the folds

cells.name: chrome_rings
cells.species: concentric bands shaded as tube cross-sections

cells.name: wavy_bands
cells.species: wavy chrome bands; the normal comes from the band gradient
eq: band s = 2(fract f − ½)/0.86,  normal along ∇f

cells.name: twisted_wires
cells.species: stranded wire ropes drifting through a sine

cells.name: spiral_coil
cells.species: a log-spiral coil of chrome tube winding into the dark

cells.name: hoop_weave
cells.species: two ring sets in steel and brass woven over and under

cells.name: organ_pipes
cells.species: chrome and brass pipes; the studio turns so reflections slide

cells.name: orbit_blobs
cells.species: orbiting metaballs thresholded into a chrome surface
eq: F = Σᵢ rᵢ²/|p − cᵢ|²,  surface at F = 1
chrome = env(r)·(F₀ + (1 − F₀)(1 − n_z)⁵),  r = reflect(−v, n)

cells.name: contour_blobs
cells.species: a lit blob rim, hairline caustic contours and dark clamped cores
eq: F = Σᵢ rᵢ²/|p − cᵢ|²,  surface at F = 1

cells.name: mercury_drops
cells.species: mercury droplets fall, touch and merge into the pool below

cells.name: lava_lamp
cells.species: glossy wax blobs rising and sinking in a glowing lamp (own tint)

cells.name: ferro_crown
cells.species: a ferrofluid mound raising a hex crown of spikes
eq: m = e^(−10r²),  d = distance to the hex spike center
lattice density 9…18,  g = 0.6…1 by pulse = ½ + ½ sin(ωt)
chrome = env(r)·(F₀ + (1 − F₀)(1 − n_z)⁵),  r = reflect(−v, n)

cells.name: chrome_tubes
cells.species: Voronoi edge distance as a tube profile: chrome tubes on black

cells.name: stained_glass
cells.species: glass panes in a lead web, backlit by a drifting lamp

cells.name: crack_glow
cells.species: a Worley crack web glowing white-hot near a drifting source (own palette)

cells.name: hex_chrome
cells.species: a hex lattice of chrome tubes that swell with a travelling wave

cells.name: bubble_raft
cells.species: a raft of pillowed chrome bubbles with an oil-film sheen

cells.name: tile_ring
cells.species: rounded metal tiles tilting on a travelling bump; a specular ring rolls out

cells.name: slat_wave
cells.species: brushed louvre slats twisting on a wave, light leaking between

cells.name: fluted_glass
cells.species: vertical fluted louvres, each sampling the light field at its own offset

cells.name: glass_blocks
cells.species: pillowed glass blocks bending the light field behind them

cells.name: oil_slick
cells.species: a thin oil film on dark liquid; thickness sets the interference color
eq: film thickness d = 160…620 nm by sin(h·(40…120) + 0.2t)
film(d) = Σλ CMF(λ)·(½ − ½ cos(2π·2·1.4·d·cos θ/λ)),  λ = 400…700

cells.name: soap_bubble
cells.species: a soap bubble; its film drains thin at the top and swirls
eq: color = film(d, n_z),  η = 1.4,  OPD = 2ηd·cos θ

cells.name: gold_leaf
cells.species: gold leaf laid in offset sheets, each sheet tilted and crinkled

cells.name: copper_tarnish
cells.species: folded copper; a thin cuprite film blooms red and violet in the valleys

cells.name: bronze_patina
cells.species: cast bronze bosses; verdigris creeps from the recesses and recedes

cells.name: anodized_ti
cells.species: anodized titanium; oxide thickness follows the height, so contours run in rainbow
eq: oxide d = V₀ + V₁·clamp(½ + 22.5·h·s, 0, 1),  V₀ = 20…50,  V₁ = 120…260 nm
color = complement of film(d, n_z, η = 2.4)

cells.name: blued_steel
cells.species: ground steel tempered from one end: straw, bronze, purple, blue, as the torch moves

cells.name: rose_facets
cells.species: a rose gold brilliant cut: rings of flat facets flash in turn as the light circles

cells.name: gunmetal
cells.species: dark gunmetal with knife-edge creases catching thin white lines

cells.name: damascus
cells.species: pattern-welded steel: etched nickel and carbon layers folded into a ladder

cells.name: chrome_sea
cells.species: a Gerstner sea of chrome rolling toward the eye under the studio sky
eq: Gerstner: x = w − Σᵢ Q·Aᵢ·d̂ᵢ cos(kᵢ d̂ᵢ·w + √(9.8kᵢ)·0.35t)

cells.name: mercury_rain
cells.species: rain on mercury: each cell of a hashed grid drops its own ring

cells.name: ferro_magnet
cells.species: a black ferrofluid film; spikes rise and lean toward a wandering magnet

cells.name: pour_stream
cells.species: a necking stream of liquid metal pours into a ringing pool

cells.name: molten_river
cells.species: a river of molten metal; crust plates drift and wrinkle over glowing seams
eq: crust plates = Voronoi(s·p′),  p′ = p − (flow·t, 0) + warp

cells.name: splash_crown
cells.species: a drop strikes chrome: a crown of droplets throws out and settles

cells.name: knurled_grip
cells.species: a diamond-knurled rod turning on its axis between plain turned shoulders

cells.name: guilloche_dial
cells.species: an engine-turned rosette dial with sunburst chapter ring and blued hands

cells.name: face_mill
cells.species: fly-cut rows of overlapping arcs; the grain glints across each tool pass

cells.name: diamond_plate
cells.species: aluminium tread plate: lozenges raised in alternate directions

cells.name: speaker_grille
cells.species: a perforated grille; through the holes a backlit woofer cone pumps

cells.name: heat_sink
cells.species: a radial heat sink: fins round a copper core, light sweeping the grain

cells.name: gear_train
cells.species: a steel gear and a brass gear in mesh, bevelled teeth catching the light

cells.name: shot_silk
cells.species: shot silk: teal warp, crimson weft, two strand highlights sliding on folds

cells.name: crumpled_foil
cells.species: crumpled aluminium foil: two scales of flat facets with creases

cells.name: sequin_field
cells.species: sequins on a hex lattice flip silver to magenta as a brush wave passes

cells.name: chainmail
cells.species: 4-in-1 chainmail: tilted steel rings, each pixel keeps the nearest ring

cells.name: satin_pleats
cells.species: a fan of wine satin knife pleats swaying, sheen along the threads

cells.name: lame_weave
cells.species: gold lamé: a 3/1 twill of gold warp over pale silver weft in soft folds, glinting

cells.name: beetle_shell
cells.species: a jewel beetle: a Bragg stack goes green at the crown, violet at the rim

cells.name: soap_film
cells.species: a flat soap film in a wire loop: drains black at the top, swirls below

cells.name: nacre
cells.species: abalone nacre: warped growth terraces in pastel interference on a pearl ground

cells.name: holo_foil
cells.species: holographic foil: grating patches throw spectra as the lamp circles

cells.name: oil_asphalt
cells.species: an oil sheen swirls on a rain puddle in wet asphalt under a street lamp

cells.name: bismuth
cells.species: bismuth hopper crystals: square stair-steps in oxide gold, magenta and blue

cells.name: chrome_curtain
cells.species: a mirror curtain on a rod; gusts roll through its folds

cells.name: pin_art
cells.species: a pin-art wall: chrome pin heads pushed out by shapes passing behind

cells.name: venetian_blinds
cells.species: chrome blinds turning in unison; a sunset city glows between slats

cells.name: vinyl_record
cells.species: a spinning record: track gaps, a turning label and a white bowtie glint

cells.name: mirror_pond
cells.species: a still mirror pond at night: drops ring out, a treeline and moon reflect

cells.name: bearing_field
cells.species: a tray of chrome ball bearings rolling on a travelling wave

cells.name: newton_cradle
cells.species: a Newton's cradle swinging over its own mirror base
